display.label: AWS Application Load Balancer
display.description: Provision Amazon Application Load Balancers (ALB) with listeners, target groups, and high-availability traffic distribution

globals.label: AWS Region
globals.description: The AWS region where resources will be provisioned.

resource.key_description: Unique identifier for the Application Load Balancer, applied as the resource name and map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core load balancer attributes including name, scheme, and IP address type.

fields.label: Load Balancer Name
fields.description: Unique name for the load balancer (up to 32 alphanumeric characters and hyphens).

validation.pattern_error: Name must be 1-32 alphanumeric characters and hyphens, and cannot start or end with a hyphen.

fields.label: Internal Load Balancer
fields.description: Whether the load balancer is internal (private VPC) or internet-facing (public).

fields.label: IP Address Type
fields.description: The type of IP addresses used by the subnets for your load balancer.

fields.label: Idle Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: The time in seconds that the connection is allowed to be idle.

fields.label: Enable Deletion Protection
fields.description: If enabled, protects the load balancer from accidental deletion via the AWS API.

sections.label: Networking & Security
sections.description: VPC, public/private subnets across multiple AZs, and security groups.

fields.label: VPC
fields.description: The VPC in which to deploy the Application Load Balancer.

fields.label: Subnets
fields.description: List of at least two public or private subnets in different Availability Zones.

fields.label: Create Dedicated Security Group
fields.description: Automatically provision a dedicated Security Group allowing inbound HTTP (80) and HTTPS (443).

fields.label: Dedicated Security Group Name
fields.description: Custom name for the dedicated security group (defaults to <name>-sg).

fields.label: Additional Security Groups
fields.description: List of existing Security Group IDs to associate with the ALB.

sections.label: Advanced Protocol & Traffic Settings
sections.description: HTTP/2, cross-zone routing, and header preservation options.

fields.label: Cross-Zone Load Balancing
fields.description: Distribute traffic evenly across all registered targets in all enabled Availability Zones.

fields.label: Enable HTTP/2
fields.description: Indicates whether HTTP/2 is enabled on the Application Load Balancer.

fields.label: Drop Invalid Header Fields
fields.description: Indicates whether HTTP headers with invalid header fields are dropped by the ALB.

fields.label: Preserve Host Header
fields.description: Preserve the Host header in HTTP requests and forward it to targets unchanged.

fields.label: Client Keep Alive (seconds)
fields.description: Client keep-alive timeout duration in seconds (range: 60 to 604800).

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: User-defined key-value tags to assign to the Application Load Balancer.
